description: This file defines a 'Module' class within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class extends the base Model class and provides a method getModule() to fetch module data from the database based on a module ID.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Handles retrieval of module information from the database within the Opencart platform.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Fetches a module record as an associative array given a module ID. Returns the 'setting' field decoded from JSON if available, or an empty array.
